About Us

השגחה וכשרות ישיבתית

Badatz Edut Fanat provides hashgacha and kashrut supervision for the yeshiva dormitory, so students and staff can rely on every business they use.

We trace every ingredient back to a reliable source, and all utensils, equipment and cooking are watched over by our mashgichim.

This directory lets you check any certificate in seconds. Each teudah is generated from our live records, so what you see always matches what we have on file.

SupervisionEvery ingredient traced to a reliable source, with all utensils and cooking watched over.
TransparencyLive records anyone can check at any time.
AccountabilityClear dates, signatures and status on every teudah.
